notice.title: Reporting significant cyber incidents
notice.aiSummary: Deposit-taking institutions must report significant cyber incidents to the Prudential Banking Board within 24 hours and submit a final incident report within 30 days after resolution. Firms must comply starting March 31, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to deposit-taking institutions, and Brivanta Bank offers consumer checking and savings accounts as well as small business deposit accounts, making it a deposit-taking institution subject to this rule.

text:
PRUDENTIAL BANKING BOARD FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Reporting significant cyber incidents
Notice number: RCN-2026-022
Issued by: Prudential Banking Board
Published: 2026-11-10
Effective date: 2027-03-31
1. Who this applies to
Deposit-taking institutions.
2. Background
Supervisors need early warning of cyber incidents that could disrupt services across the sector.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must report a significant cyber incident to the Prudential Banking Board within 24 hours of determining that the incident is significant.
3.2 A firm must send the Prudential Banking Board a final incident report with root cause and remediation within 30 days after the incident is resolved.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-03-31.
Synthetic document written for a Snowflake example. The regulator, rule and numbers are fictional.

obligations.text: A firm must report a significant cyber incident to the Prudential Banking Board within 24 hours of determining that the incident is significant.
obligations.controlDesc: Breach log review confirms supervisor notification within 72 hours for each reportable breach
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CYB-01 states "Significant cyber incidents are reported to the Prudential Banking Board within 24 hours of being classified as significant" which exactly matches the obligation's 24-hour deadline and scope, and Control CTL-221 confirms "supervisor notification within 24 hours of a significant classification" which would detect non-compliance with this specific reporting requirement.

obligations.text: A firm must send the Prudential Banking Board a final incident report with root cause and remediation within 30 days after the incident is resolved.
obligations.controlDesc: Final incident reports tracked to submission within 30 days of resolution
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CYB-01 states "A final report with root cause and remediation follows within 30 days of resolution" and Control CTL-222 tracks "Final incident reports tracked to submission within 30 days of resolution," both matching the obligation's 30-day deadline and scope exactly.
